items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Bart Starr...you know who I'm talking about.

ctx.x: He'd come over there on a scholarship. They had brought about six Indians over there -- some Sioux, Blackfoot, Nez Perce(?)... And they were my best friends! I liked them better than I liked anybody in the whole school.

And I remember Tony Canadeo(?) was there when I was there. Years and years later, I was in Los Angeles, and I was playing with my trio, and the team that he was playing was... What was it? The one that won for so many years. Canadeo and the big-time coach that was such a wheel... Bart Starr...you know who I'm talking about. Detroit? No, it
